long_biography.plain_text:
Allgeier became Carl Georg Dürschmidt’s principal technology platform after he and partners acquired the founder’s shares in 2001. He had moved from strategy consulting into German SME investment, co-founded a private investment company and learnt to combine portfolio management with board responsibility.

As chief executive, Dürschmidt used acquisitions and organic development to build Allgeier into a software and IT-services group. He then oversaw the separation of the global consulting and software-development business as Nagarro, creating a second listed company. After leaving executive management, he moved to supervisory oversight, continuing as Allgeier’s board chairman while retaining substantial indirect interests through Lantano.

uncertainties.detail: No independent public source was found that securely connects Dürschmidt to the cohort vessel. The identity is nevertheless resolved at very high confidence because the authoritative owner record contains an unusually specific Allgeier career and shareholder description that matches the exact German corporate identity, birth year and current role. Vessel names and ownership claims are excluded from both biographies.

Nagarro's audited 2025 report attributes an indirect 18.9% interest to Dürschmidt and records Lantano's continuing significant influence. The filing also attributes the same voting rights to several family members, so the percentage should not be read as his unshared beneficial interest. The August 2026 Allgeier transfer confirms a current Lantano connection but does not establish his complete current Allgeier percentage.

Dürschmidt resigned as Nagarro supervisory-board chairman and member effective 1 May 2025 and was reappointed as an ordinary member in July 2025. Current biographies and classifications treat him only as an ordinary Nagarro board member, never as its current chairman.

Official sources establish an investment-company career, co-founding activity, acquisition of the Allgeier founder's shares and subsequent company building. They do not disclose the source of his acquisition capital or whether early work in a family business supplied material advantages. Broad Self-made is therefore used without asserting either an independent-start or advantaged-start subtype.

The stored LinkedIn URL could not be independently verified from an accessible profile, and searches surfaced several exact-name LinkedIn candidates in Bavaria, including a profile associated with Allgeier. No replacement LinkedIn is proposed without a decisive account-level bridge. No identity-secure Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was found; the official Allgeier company website is proposed instead.

No private-vessel detail, sale listing, ranking, unsupported net-worth estimate or point-in-time company valuation appears in either biography. Nothing was compiled, synchronised, applied to the live website or added to the tag catalogue.
